LESSON: HYGIENE IN REARING ANIMALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTISES Strand Sub- Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learni
Topic 3.1: Hygiene in Rearing Animals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hygiene in Rearing Animals, part of HYGIENE PRACTISES Strand Sub- Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learni in Grade 7 AGRICULTURE.

Key inquiry question: How can we maintain hygiene while rearing animals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hygiene in Rearing Animals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Responsibility: engaging in assigned roles while carrying out hygiene practises in rearing domestic animals.

Animal welfare as learners observe hygiene practises in rearing domestic animals.
